                                      xxxxxx    Clark Yang Shu Yuen.

My name is Ts'i Li Ming, age 46, native of Pootung,
M/unemployed coolie, residing No. 7 Tish Poh Li,
North Kiangse Road.

Since the "813" hostilities in Shanghai, I and
Li Ta Kung began to organize a "Coolie Guild" in the
Shanghai General Chamber of Commerce, located at North
Honan Road. In September 1940, after the assassination
of Lin Ta Kung, I together with Koh Chun Ming, a six
years old friend of mine, became members of the
Information Dept. of the Special Affairs Organization
No. 10 Loong Hung Tsung, Hang An Ka, Nantao, after
having been introduced by somebody. In July 1941,
through the introduction of one San Kou (Japanese), I
and Koh Chun Ming became members in the "Sing Yap
Construction Army Information Dept." attached to the
"Anti-Communist Union", in charge of San Pung Go
Leung (Japanese), 18 Shien Ko Ka, Nantao. Koh Chun
Ming was the chief of the aforementioned department.
It was usual that he despatched the all information which
he obtained from time to time to the Special Affairs
Organization and to San Pung Go Leung (Japanese).

At 7 a.m. on 14/1/42, I left my home and after having
sent four copies of information to the Special Affairs
Organization, Nantao, which had been handed over to
me by Koh Chung Ming at his home, I proceeded to
Merryland Restaurant, No. 25 Kin Wo Ka, where we met
each morning, this we had been so doing for the past
two months.

本人名为 Ts'i Li Ming，46岁，浦东人，
职业/无业苦力，住江西路北侧提婆里7号。

自上海“八一三”事变以来，我与
Li Ta Kung 开始在位于河南路北侧的
上海总商会组织“苦力公会”。1940年9月，在 Lin Ta Kung 被暗杀后，经人介绍，我与相识六年的朋友 Koh Chun Ming 一同加入位于南市恒安街龙兴宗10号的特务组织情报部。1941年7月，经一名叫 San Kou 的日本人介绍，我与 Koh Chun Ming 加入附属于“反共联盟”的“兴亚建设军情报部”，该部由日本人 San Pung Go Leung 负责，地址为南市咸瓜街18号。Koh Chun Ming 任上述部门主管。他通常将不时获取的情报发送给特务组织及日本人 San Pung Go Leung。

1942年1月14日上午7时，我离开家，在将 Koh Chung Ming 在其家中交给我的四份情报送往南市特务组织后，前往金和街25号精美酒楼，这是我们过去两个月来每天早晨见面的地方。

pages.en:
I arrived at the restaurant at about 9 a.m. said date,
About 15 minutes later, Koh Chun Ming arrived. I and
Koh Chung Ming seated at No. 15 our backs to door and
windows. Present were also some of Koh Chu: Ming's friends
unknown to me, and more of his members who were sitting at
three other tables i.e. No. 12, 13 and 17. At about
10.15 a.m. said date, suddenly a continuous stream of shots
were fired from behind Koh Chun Ming and myself. Both
being shot, I fell to the ground. During the shooting,
I did not know in what direction our assailants decamped
or from where was fired from. A few minutes later, I
was conveyed to the Lester Chinese Hospital by Police
Officers.
True statement.

Signed.

陈述属实。

The 1st named was found lying in the Road just

1942年1月14日上午10时27分，通过南京路与浙江路拐角处的16号街头电话亭，接到第532号印籍巡长的电话报告，称金和街（南京路）刚刚发生枪击事件。

由主管警官率领的一组警员响应捕房警报赶赴现场。抵达后经查明，四名中国男子，名为：-

(1) Koh Chuen Ming（郭君明），别名 Ko Liang Tien（郭亮天），41岁，已婚，“兴亚”建设军总部特务局官员，总部地址南市咸瓜街18号，住爱文义路七段607号。

(2) Tai Li Ming（戴立明），49岁，上海人，“兴亚”建设军总部特务局联络官，总部地址南市咸瓜街18号，住天津路天费里7号。

“大腿枪伤，伤势稍重，需治疗二至四周。”

(3) Tu Pao Hua（杜宝华），42岁，镇江人，商人，已婚，住武定路玉庆坊96号。
莱斯医院医生证明写道：-
“送达时已死亡。”

(4) Yu Chuen Shoo（余均秀），26岁，扬州人，单身，教师，金和街25号精美酒楼精美里2号职员。住卡特路附近张家宅路48/70弄。
莱斯医院医生证明写道：-
“腹部右侧枪伤，伤势极重，需治疗四周。”

于1942年1月14日上午约10时10分20秒，在金和街25号精美酒楼精美里就座时，于数分钟前遭枪击。

(8) Woo Foh Tien（夏福田），28岁，乍浦人，侍者，受雇于精美酒楼，住山西北路262/11弄。

已被找到，他们在枪击发生时在场。前四名证人与受害者相识，除了第四名受害者，他是一名侍者。而第五、六、七、八名证人是受雇于精美酒楼的侍者。证词已记录在案，附后。

此外，在现场拾获五枚空弹壳和三枚已发射子弹，口径9毫米，以及三枚.32口径空弹壳。已送交武器鉴定科。

通过对证人的讯问及对枪击现场的检查，以下是可能发生的事情经过：-

第一、二、三名受害者与第一、二、三、四名证人在过去两个月中，习惯于每天早晨通常在上午9时30分至10时之间见面聚会。

pages.en:
1/5.

at the Merryland Restaurant, known in Chinese as the
Ching Mei(精美). Here, seated at three or more
small tables placed around a stove in the centre of the
Restaurant they talked and drank tea, usually staying
an hour or more. At about 10.20 a.m. on the 14/1/42
three unknown male Chinese, two seen to be armed, no
detailed description available other than that they wore
long Chinese black gowns, entered via the Restaurant front
entrance and approaching their victims opened fire at a
range of approximately six feet.

Injuries sustained as related in the foregoing. The
waiter, 4th named, was at the time tending the wants of
the occupants of the tables in question.

No sooner had they fired a fusilade of shots they
had then decamped via the front entrance. Nothing definite
as to the direction of their escape has, to date, been
established. It is possible that when coming out of the
Restaurant, they ran south along Kin Wo Ka thence mingling
with the heavy pedestrian traffic of this Police District
made good their escape.

The assassins having left, the 1st named victim had
staggered from the premises and thence north along Kin Wo
Ka only to collapse at Nanking Road intersection, where
he was found on the arrival of the Police. The 2nd named
had staggered from his table a few feet towards the
pages.zh:
1/5.

在精美餐厅（Merryland Restaurant），中文名为“精美”。当时，他们坐在餐厅中央炉子周围摆放的三张或更多小桌旁，交谈并饮茶，通常停留一小时或更久。1942年1月14日上午约10时20分，三名身份不明的中国男子进入，其中两人被看到持有武器，除身穿黑色长衫外无其他详细描述。他们经由餐厅正门进入，走近受害者，在约六英尺的距离内开火射击。

伤情如前所述。第四位具名者（服务员）当时正在照料上述桌位顾客的所需。

他们发射了一排子弹后，随即经由正门逃窜。截至目前，尚未确定其逃跑的确切方向。有可能他们在走出餐厅后，沿静安寺路（Kin Wo Ka）向南奔跑，随后混入本警区密集的人流中成功逃脱。

刺客离开后，第一位具名受害者踉跄着走出场所，随后沿静安寺路向北走去，最终在南京路口倒地，警察到达时发现了他。第二位具名者从桌位向

pages.en:
1/6.

Restaurant entrance, having staggered out had collapsed.
Police in the vicinity, Corporal Mozalevsky, R.A.D.
230 and constable Evtropoff, No.73 at the time were
patrolling east along the north side of Nanking Road
having just crossed Kwangse Road intersection. These
officers observing a crowd congregated at Nanking and
Kin Wo Ka on investigating were informed by an unknown
boy that a shooting had just taken place in the Kin Wo
Ka. Proceeding to the Merryland Restaurant they observed
that as is already related, the assassins having already
made good their escape. Meanwhile, Havildar No.532
patrolling District had, likewise, observed a crowd at
the aforementioned location and on seeing a man lying
apparently wounded had immediately telephoned this Station.
C.P.C.1345 on traffic duty at Nanking and the Kin Wo Ka
heard sounds similar to pistol shots and on looking about
observed a man lying a few feet away from him apparently
wounded. He had then ran south along Kin Wo Ka, but on
arriving at the Restaurant, also learned that the
assassins had already made good their escape.

The unmentioned listed property was found on the
persons of the injured and the bodies of the deceased:-

1st named:
1 identity card, 3 cheques, 2 keys, 1 gold pocket watch
and gold chain, $960 in notes, 1 silver dollar,
$ HK50.14, 2 diamond rings, 1 gold wrist watch,
1 pair of spectacles, 2 fountain pens, and papers.
pages.zh:
1/6.

餐厅入口方向踉跄走了几英尺，走出后便倒地。附近的警察，皇家亚洲文会北华支会（R.A.D.）第230号巡长莫扎列夫斯基（Mozalevsky）和第73号警员叶夫特罗波夫（Evtropoff），当时正沿南京路北侧向东巡逻，刚经过广西路口。这些警官观察到南京路与静安寺路交汇处聚集了人群，经调查，一名不知名男孩告知他们静安寺路刚刚发生了枪击案。他们前往精美餐厅，发现正如前述，刺客已经成功逃脱。与此同时，在该区域巡逻的第532号印度警士也观察到上述地点有人群聚集，在看到一人显然受伤躺在地上后，立即致电本警局。在南京路与静安寺路路口执行交通任务的第1345号中国警务警员听到了类似手枪射击的声音，环顾四周发现一名男子躺在离他不远的地方，显然受了伤。他随后沿静安寺路向南跑去，但到达餐厅时，也得知刺客已经成功逃脱。

在伤者和死者身上发现了以下未提及的财物：

第一位具名者：
身份证1张，支票3张，钥匙2把，金怀表及金链1套，纸币960元，银元1枚，港币50.14元，钻戒2枚，金腕表1只，眼镜1副，钢笔2支，以及文件若干。

pages.en:
1/7.

2nd named.
1 warrant card, 1 note book, $100 in notes,
1 pair of spectacles, 1 chop ink, 1 fountain
pen and papers.

3rd named.
1 Japanese Pass, 5 pawnpapers, $26.00 in notes,
1 wrist watch, 1 piece of jade, 1 wallet, 1 receipt,
2 pairs of spectacles.

handed over to memberof the Japanese Gendarmerie.

It is well to mention,there appears to be no doubt
that the whole shooting took place inside the Merryland
Restaurant. D.S.I. Rhodes and the undersigned observed
and traced blood spots on the Roadway. These spots led
from the Restaurant entrance to the spot where the 1st
named victim was found lying; the intersection of Kin Wo
Ka and Nanking Road.

The D.O. and D.D.O."A" Division were in attendance
and the entire block surrounding the vicinity of the
scene of the shooting was cordoned off and cleared of
pedestrians by members of the Reserve Unit.

This area is now cordoned off by members of the
Japanese Gendarmerie.

The bodies of the 1st and 3rd named victims were
removed to the Public Mortuary pending inquest on the
morning of the 15/1/42. Witnesses and relatives warned
to attend. Japanese Authorities informed.

Enquiries are being made by every available detective
at all lodging houses, hotels and other likely haunts.

Ching Sung.

委任证1张，笔记本1本，纸币100元，

已移交给日本宪兵队成员。

值得一提的是，毫无疑问，整个枪击事件发生在精美餐厅内部。副督察罗德兹（Rhodes）和本人观察并追踪了路面上的血迹。这些血迹从餐厅入口延伸至第一位具名受害者被发现倒地的地点；即静安寺路与南京路的交叉口。

“A”分区督察和副分区督察到场，后备队成员封锁并清除了枪击现场周围整个街区内的行人。

该区域现由日本宪兵队成员封锁。

第一和第三位具名受害者的遗体已被移送至公立殓房，等候于1942年1月15日上午进行死因研讯。已警告证人和亲属出席。已通知日本当局。

所有可用的侦探正在对所有寄宿处、旅馆及其他可能的藏身之处进行调查。

Daung Yoh Tse (唐育之), age 30,
self.
Louza Stn. 14-1-42 translated Clerk Sih.
//////

I am a cashier employed at the Merryland Restaurant,
25 Kin We Ka.

This morning I came on duty at 8.a.m. (14-1-42).
Unexpectedly, at about 10.a.m. shooting affray occurred in
the shop, 4 or 5 gun shots having been fired. At the time
I became very frightened, so I crouched down behind the
accountant desk. I did not take notice about the man who
had opened the fire.

Later I found an apprentice Yue Hoong Zeu lying on the
floor, wounded. A foreign dressed patron also received injury
at his leg. One other man was found dead outside the shop.
Police Officers attended.
True statement.

Signed: Daung Yoh Tse.
pages.zh:
唐育之（Daung Yoh Tse），30岁，
自述。
老闸捕房 1942年1月14日 翻译 司事 Sih。
//////

我是静安寺路25号精美餐厅的收银员。

今天早上我于上午8时上班（1942年1月14日）。出乎意料的是，上午约10时，店内发生了枪击冲突，响了4或5枪。当时我非常害怕，所以蹲在会计桌后面。我没有注意是谁开的枪。

后来我发现学徒岳洪洲（Yue Hoong Zeu，音译）受伤躺在地板上。一名穿西装的顾客腿部也受了伤。另有一人在店外被发现死亡。
警官到场处理。
陈述属实。

签名：唐育之。

Woo Yoong 胡永 (胡永), age 55,
self
Kemp
translated
Louza Stn.    14-1-42    //////    Clerk Sih.

I reside at 45 Chang Chun Fong off Changan Road,
Chapei, being employed as an officer i/c 2nd Section of
Goro Yamamoto's Information Bureau, 18 Hai Kuo Ka, Nantao.
The officer i/c of the Bureau named Kuo Chun Ming and I
frequented the Merry-land Restaurant, 25 Kin Wo Ka.
At about 9.30 a.m. 14-1-42, I together with my friend
Han Yoh Yoh were partaking food at the above restaurant.
About 20 minutes later, Kuo Chun Ming, officer i/c of the
Information Bureau, arrived, and we sat at a table.
About half an hour later, at the time we were convers-
ing, three persons wearing Chinese style overcoats entered
the restaurant and opened fire at the table we were sitting
around. I immediately ran to the kitchen and later Police
Officers attended the scene and made investigations.
True statement.

Signed and cross-marked:
Woo Yoong
pages.zh:
胡永（Woo Yoong），55岁，
自述
肯普（Kemp，音译）
翻译
老闸捕房    1942年1月14日    //////    司事 Sih。

我居住在闸北长安路长春坊45号，受雇为山本五郎情报局第二科科长，该局位于南市海阔路18号。情报局局长名叫郭春明（Kuo Chun Ming，音译），我和他经常去静安寺路25号的精美餐厅。
1942年1月14日上午约9时30分，我和我的朋友韩学悦（Han Yoh Yoh，音译）在上述餐厅用餐。大约20分钟后，情报局局长郭春明到达，我们坐在一张桌旁。
大约半小时后，当我们正在交谈时，三个穿着中式大衣的人进入餐厅，向我们所坐的桌子开火。我立即跑进厨房，后来警官到场进行了调查。
陈述属实。

签名并画押：
胡永

pages.en:
Han Yoh Yoeh 韩学悦, age 53.
C.D.S.336
Kompo                      translated   Clerk 3ih.
Louza Stn.        14-1-42       //////

I am an informer, residing at Lane 21/16 Tatung Road,
Chapei. I own the San Sing Public Ricsha Company at the
above address. On 15-12-41, through my friend Woo Yoong's
introduction, I obtained my present job at 18 Hai Kuo Ka,
Nantao, an Information Bureau under the direction of Goro
Yamamoto, the Chinese leader being one named Kuo Chun Ming
(now the deceased). Being notified by Kuo Chun Ming the
previous day, I, at 9.30 a.m. 14-1-41, attended the Merry-land
Restaurant, 25 Kin Wo Ka, accompanied by Wee Yoong. We sat
at a table in the centre of the shop near a stove, drinking tea.
After remaining for about 15 minutes, Kuo Chun Ming, Sze Lih
Ming et al arrived, and we drank tea at separate tables. Then
Kuo Chun Ming said to us that we should report duty at the
Squad at 9.a.m. the 15-1-42. Following this, I suddenly
heard about 5 or 6 gun shots being fired from my rear, where-
upon I immediately lay on the floor whilst Kue Chun Ming et al
ran out. However, I did not see the assassin. Later Police
Officers attended the scene and called me to Station for
questioning. True statement.
Sgd. & cross-marked.

韩学悦（Han Yoh Yoeh），53岁。
中国侦探组 336号
康波（Kompo，音译）                      翻译   司事 3ih。
老闸捕房        1942年1月14日       //////

我是一名线人，居住在闸北大同路21弄16号。我在上述地址拥有三星公共人力车公司。1941年12月15日，通过我的朋友胡永的介绍，我在南市海阔路18号获得了目前的工作，这是一个在山本五郎指导下的情报局，中方负责人名叫郭春明（现已故）。前一天接到郭春明的通知后，我于1941年1月14日上午9时30分（原文如此，应为1942年），在胡永的陪同下前往静安寺路25号的精美餐厅。我们坐在店铺中央靠近炉子的一张桌子旁饮茶。
停留了大约15分钟后，郭春明、施立明等人到达，我们在不同的桌子旁饮茶。随后郭春明对我们说，我们应该于1942年1月15日上午9时向小队报到。紧接着，我突然听到身后响了大约5或6声枪响，于是我立即趴在地上，而郭春明等人跑了出去。然而，我没有看到刺客。后来警官到场，并叫我去警局接受询问。陈述属实。
签名并画押。

S Foh Ming (史福民), age 47,
Wai-an, Kiangsu                      Self
                                     translated
Lruza Stn.          14-1-42          ///////      Clerk Sih.

I reside at 198 Lei Yien Li off Fuchow Road, Hongkew.
I am the inspector in charge of Shanghai Branch, Kiangsu
Provincial Pigs Monopoly & Tax Bureau.
At about 9.20 a.m. 14-1-42, I was in the Merryland
Restaurant, drinking tea at a table. I met Kuo Chun Ming
who told me that he would give an invitation at the Nanking
Restaurant at 5.p.m. 14-1-42. Later I paid off my bill $2.
and left the restaurant.
On reaching at the entrance to the Great Eastern

I saw Kuo Chun Ming running out of the restaurant, turning
towards Nanking Road. On being questioned, he (Kuo) said
to me he had been shot and requested me to call ambulance
with the assistance of Police. He also requested me to

Signed: S Foh Ming.

史福民（S Foh Ming），47岁，
江苏淮安                      自述
                                     翻译
老闸捕房          1942年1月14日          ///////      司事 Sih。

我居住在虹口福州路雷音里198号。我是江苏省猪业统税局上海分局的稽查主任。

25 Kin Wo Ra.

and reported duty at the restaurant at 8.a.m.  I performed
my daily work, such as cleaning etc.  Many patrons entered
the shop and they drank tea at four separate tables. I was
in company with one of my colleagues outside the lavatory,
cooking some food, when I suddenly heard three or four

ran to the kitchen and at that time the shop's patrons

C.P.C.1345 Dien Pao Zien (田寶泉),
self
Louza Stn. 14-2-42 translated Clerk Sih.
///////

I beg to report that, between 7.a.m. and 11.a.m. on
14-1-42, I would be on duty on Nanking Road near Kin Wo Ka.
At about 10.25 a.m. 14-1-42, I heard two gun shots being
fired and on turning round I saw one man walking and he even-
tually collapsed on the pavement, having apparently received
injuries. A crowd of pedestrians ran Southwards and I went
to the entrance to the Hwa Yang Barber Shop when I observed
several persons in the Merryland, wounded. Therefore I

老闸捕房 1942年2月14日（原文如此，应为1月） 翻译 司事 Sih。
///////

谨报告，1942年1月14日上午7时至11时之间，我在南京路近静安寺路路口执勤。1942年1月14日上午约10时25分，我听到两声枪响，回头看见一名男子行走，随后倒在人行道上，显然受了伤。一群行人向南跑去，我走到华阳理发店门口，观察到精美餐厅内有数人受伤。因此，我使用了华阳百货店的电话，向警局报告了这一事件。

书写：中国警务警员 1345号 (I)。

Yangchow                                self
Louza Stn.          14-1-42         translated
                                    ////////      Clerk 3ih.

I am a teaboy employed at the Merryland Restaurant,
25 Kin Wo Ka.
    This morning at about 10.a.m. 14-1-42, whilst cooking
in the kitchen at the above address, I suddenly heard about
10 gun shots being fired from the shop.
    Later I came to the shop centre when I found one
patron and one teaboy lying on the floor, wounded.
    Police officers attended.
    I knew nothing further.
    True statement.

                Signed: Yong Tuh Shing, Waiter No.29.
